summary: Round 2: both major findings from round 1 are genuinely fixed, confirmed by mutation (not eyeballed). (1) test_failed_reason_with_secret_is_sanitized_in_recap embeds a real TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN value inside a failing slot's exception, drives it through the real job() -> sanitize_error_message -> recap_failures.append((link, safe)) pipeline, and asserts the [E034] ping contains [REDACTED] and NOT the raw secret. Mutating `recap_failures.append((link, safe))` to `(link, str(err))` in news_bot.py makes this test fail with the raw secret ('TOPSECRET_bot_value_42') visible in the assertion diff; reverted cleanly. (2) The moved_to_failed tail is now pinned twice: the unit test asserts the exact string 'провалов: 1 (снято после 3 промахов: 1)', a sibling negative test asserts the tail is ABSENT when moved==0, and a new integration test drives a row through 3 real strikes (increment_attempt -> move_to_failed) and asserts the same exact-tail string plus that the row actually lands in failed_articles. Mutating the builder's tail computation to `tail = ""` makes BOTH the unit test and the new integration test fail; reverted cleanly. All 3 previously-flagged minors are also resolved: the dict-guard now has its own dedicated test (test_non_dict_recap_pins_explicit_guard_message) whose exact-message assertion breaks when the guard is mutated to `if False:` (confirmed by mutation and restored) — the older test_broken_recap_input_does_not_raise still doesn't pin the guard on its own, exactly as round 1 predicted, but the gap is now closed by the new dedicated test sitting alongside it; the cap test uses assertEqual(len(rendered), 5) (exact, not <=); and _recap_failure_lines' non-list branch is exercised by test_malformed_failures_value_renders_tally_without_failure_lines. The old secret-scrub unit test (test_builder_never_renders_raw_secret_text) is honestly re-scoped via comment as belt-and-suspenders pointing at the new integration test for real coverage, rather than implying the builder itself redacts. No regressions found: news_bot.PUBLISH_RECAP_MAX_FAILURES is coupled to admin_alerts.RECAP_MAX_FAILURES (verified equal at runtime, 5==5), the non-dict fallback and the inner-exception fallback both render 🟡 (unified), no existing assertion was weakened (the cap assertion was strengthened, not loosened), and no over-mocking was introduced beyond the pre-existing job()-boundary mocking pattern already accepted in round 1 (datetime/sleep/compute_fixed_slots/_publish_with_retries/SOURCES/send_admin_notification — all pre-existing integration-test boundaries in this file, not new). Full targeted suite: 105/105 passed both before and after every mutation-and-revert cycle. Approved.
